pkgmetadata.longdescription: gomobile is Google's official Go mobile toolchain. It drives the cross-compilation of Go code for Android (APK / AAR) and iOS (.app / framework) targets and generates language bindings (Java, Objective-C) from Go packages. Two binaries ship: `gomobile` (build/bind/init orchestrator) and `gobind` (binding generator). Pure Go with no native linkage of its own; invokes Android NDK and/or Xcode at the user's request when producing mobile artifacts. Upstream uses Go pseudo- versions only — this ebuild pins a specific snapshot commit.
